seed: Help now holds a Tutorials submenu built from the catalogue: the promoted guide, one submenu per track that has something on it, and the way into the Tutorials window. The window is where progress lives, because a command menu bakes its item titles in when it is built and a row carrying where you got to went stale. So the menu must read the same at every stage of this walk, and the window must not.

steps.note: the menu: Take the Tour promoted at the top, then Basics as a submenu holding the whole track, the promoted guide included, then All Tutorials. No flat list of every guide anywhere in it, and no empty submenu for the six tracks with nothing on them yet.
nothing run yet: each track with its guides, how long each takes, the button reading Start, no tick, no More menu, and no Reset All because there is nothing to reset
the window read the way a screen reader reads it: every row says what it is and how long it takes, and every button says which guide it belongs to. A button with no words is a failure here.
left on step two: the row says where you stopped, the button reads Continue, a More menu appears for the one guide with something to forget, and Reset All has come up at the bottom
the menu is unchanged, on purpose: every word a menu row says is true whatever you have done before
finished: the row carries a tick, the track counts itself, the status line reads Finished and the button offers to run it again
still the same menu. Ticks belong in the window, where there is room to say it once per row and count it per track.
pressing a finished guide's own button runs it again: the hub gets out of the way, and the guide starts from the top rather than doing something odd
